gate_thresholds.secondary_ground_failure_gate: at least 3 signals and landslides ranked second to structural collapse
gate_thresholds.strong_sequence_gate: later_M6plus_ratio>=0.50, reported aftershock M>=7.0, lag<=20 days
gate_thresholds.surface_change_not_primary_gate: reported no surface rupture and no usable Sentinel-1 pre/post pair establishing an image-led primary explanation

decision_rule.summary: Compute six gates for shaking, strong-shock sequence, collapse exposure, secondary ground failure, surface-change nonlead status, and rainfall nonlead status. The final label is assigned only when all gates pass.

strong_sequence_gate.catalog_count_scope: Package ComCat query count; the report-cited May 12 M7.3 aftershock is recorded separately below.

surface_change_not_primary_gate.surface_change_inference: Sentinel-1 has no usable post-event pair here, so it does not prove absence of change; the non-primary gate relies on the report's no-surface-rupture statement and lack of image-led support.

provenance.notes: Computed from local CSX-234 package files only.

criteria.description: Returns all six named gates, per-gate values, pass/fail results, final label, rejected leads, and one concise interpretation.
criteria.name: Requested JSON structure

criteria.description: Computes the specified magnitude, depth, EMS midpoint, sequence ratio, aftershock lag, housing ratios, exposure ratio, surface ratio, and precipitation metrics within tolerance, while distinguishing package-catalog sequence counts from the separately reported May 12 aftershock.
criteria.name: Numeric calculations

criteria.description: Applies all gate thresholds correctly and assigns the final label only after all six gates pass.
criteria.name: Gate logic

criteria.description: Explains how the values establish collapse-led shallow earthquake sequence consistency, keep ground failures secondary, and avoid treating missing Sentinel-1 post scenes as proof of no surface change.
criteria.name: Proof reasoning

criteria.description: Rejects at least two tempting lead interpretations using computed gates: landslide-led, image/surface-change-led, or rainfall-led; image-led rejection must be based on no surface rupture plus absent paired image support, not on a claim of observed no-change.
criteria.name: Rejected leads

criteria.description: Uses a short final mechanism label consistent with the calculations.
criteria.name: Concise label

criteria.description: Keeps the answer bounded to the numeric proof and requested computed fields, including the catalog/report sequence distinction and Sentinel-1 availability limit.
criteria.name: Overclaim control
